implementation: MurmurHash3 x86-32 and xxHash32: two seeded native-backed mmh3/xxhash hashes; FNV-1a 64: two domain-prefixed native-backed fnv-c hashes; MD5 and BLAKE2b: hashlib digests split into two 64-bit words. BLAKE2b uses the original seed salt; other hashes include the seed in input. Execution time in milliseconds covers insertion and all present/absent queries, excluding input generation, allocation and output. Timings are implementation-specific.
